title: unified-rollouts: refactor autorollback engine and add stability guards for canary/A-B/shadow
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Motivation: unify the autorollback logic for canary, A/B and shadow rollouts into a single evaluable engine that supports multi-metric thresholds, transparent metric matching, and stability guards. This PR refactors the rollout controller to decouple evaluation from routing, introduces a pluggable evaluation pipeline, and adds golden e2e tests that exercise rollback paths under noisy metrics. Checklist: - [x] refactor rollout evaluation to new pipeline - [x] add stability guard heuristics and configurable cooldowns - [x] add comprehensive unit tests for evaluation steps - [x] add e2e tests that simulate metric noise and verify rollback - [x] update observability: expose per-rollout metrics and traces - [x] feature-flag rollout to allow gradual rollout of changes - [x] update docs and API types - [x] manual testing in staging: passed. Detailed changes and rationale: consolidating metric evaluation avoids duplicated logic and inconsistent rollback behavior between canary/AB/shadow modes. The new engine supports composite metric expressions (weighted error + latency), configurable aggregation windows, and a conservative stability guard that requires sustained violations before triggering an automatic rollback. To reduce blast radius we added a cooldown/backoff policy and a safety net that will only autorollback if traffic tier and model compatibility checks pass. This change addresses production incidents INT-2024-45 and improves determinism in low-traffic canaries.

review_comments: Liam Chen: The evaluator looks much cleaner, but I'm worried about the default aggregation window — in low traffic canaries it might be too small and cause flapping. Suggested: increase default to 1 minute and add an override.
Sofia Martinez: Agreed — bumped default to 60s and added a per-rollout override config (cooldown.window_seconds). Added unit test to cover low-traffic behavior.
Priya Nair: Observability looks good. Could we add a sample Grafana panel and alert rule for rollout_failure_rate?
Sofia Martinez: Added grafana/dashboard JSON and an alert rule in docs; left it disabled by default (opt-in).
Ethan Wong: CI flakes observed on the e2e harness (timeout on sim step). Request increasing timeout for the noisy-metrics scenario.
Sofia Martinez: Increased timeout and added retry for flaky step; re-ran CI — all green.

release_notes: Enhancement: Unified autorollback engine for rollouts (canary/A-B/shadow) with multi-metric evaluation, stability guards, and cooldown policies. Added e2e scenarios and new observability metrics: rollout_evaluation_latency_ms, rollout_failure_rate. Migration: rollout API extends with cooldown and composite_metric fields — see docs/rollouts/autorollback.md for migration steps.
notes: This PR aims to reduce inconsistent rollback behavior observed across rollout modes and to make autorollback decisions more explainable. Feature is behind rollout_evaluator_v2 feature flag for staged rollout.
